scripts.copy-static: mkdir -p dist/tabbar dist/passwords dist/history dist/omnibox dist/assets dist/main/mcp && cp src/tabbar/tabbar.html src/tabbar/tabbar.css src/tabbar/empty.html src/tabbar/empty.css src/tabbar/tokens.css dist/tabbar/ && cp src/passwords/passwords.html src/passwords/passwords.css dist/passwords/ && cp src/history/history.html src/history/history.css dist/history/ && cp src/omnibox/omnibox.html src/omnibox/omnibox.css dist/omnibox/ && cp assets/offline.html dist/assets/ && cp src/main/mcp/toolManifest.json dist/main/mcp/
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run copy-static
scripts.start: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron .
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:bench: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.bench.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:shots: npm run build && AGENT_SHOTS=1 playwright test --config playwright.bench.config.ts e2e/bench-agent-layout-screens.spec.ts
scripts.dist: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
